property_summary: For any caller and any address, calling setOwner must revert unless the caller is the current owner, so a non-owner can never change owner; the buggy version lets any caller succeed and change owner, violating this for non-owner callers.
change_summary: Remove the `onlyOwner` modifier from setOwner so any caller can change the owner.
